content.json:
# 🤖 Dashboard de Agentes MAF

Este workbook muestra métricas y trazas de los agentes del workshop Microsoft Agent Framework.

---

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agent.invocations.total"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize TotalInvocations = sum(value) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: Invocaciones por Tiempo

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agent.invocations.errors"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize TotalErrors = sum(value) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: Errores por Tiempo

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agent.latency"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize 
    p50 = percentile(value, 50),
    p95 = percentile(value, 95),
    p99 = percentile(value, 99),
    avg_latency = avg(value)
    by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| project timestamp, p50, p95, p99
| render timechart
content.title: Latencia del Agente (Percentiles)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agent.latency"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize 
    avg_latency = avg(value),
    min_latency = min(value),
    max_latency = max(value),
    count = count()
| project 
    ['Promedio (ms)'] = round(avg_latency, 2),
    ['Mínimo (ms)'] = round(min_latency, 2),
    ['Máximo (ms)'] = round(max_latency, 2),
    ['Total Mediciones'] = count
content.title: Resumen de Latencia

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agent.tokens.total"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize TotalTokens = sum(value) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: Consumo de Tokens por Tiempo

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agent.tokens.total"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize TotalTokens = sum(value) by tostring(customDimensions.model)
| render piechart
content.title: Tokens por Modelo

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agent.invocations.total"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Invocations = sum(value) by UserId = tostring(customDimensions.user_id)
| top 10 by Invocations desc
content.title: Top 10 Usuarios por Invocaciones

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "agent.latency"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize AvgLatency = avg(value) by UserId = tostring(customDimensions.user_id)
| top 10 by AvgLatency desc
content.title: Latencia Promedio por Usuario

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where severityLevel >= 3
| project 
    timestamp,
    message,
    severityLevel,
    UserId = tostring(customDimensions.UserId),
    ErrorType = tostring(customDimensions.ErrorType)
| order by timestamp desc
| take 50
content.title: Últimos Errores

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where target contains "openai"
| summarize 
    AvgDuration = avg(duration),
    SuccessRate = 100.0 * countif(success == true) / count()
    by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| project timestamp, AvgDuration, SuccessRate
| render timechart
content.title: Llamadas a Azure OpenAI

content.json:
---

### 📚 Instrucciones para usar este Workbook

1. En el portal de Azure, navega a tu recurso de Application Insights
2. Ve a **Workbooks** en el menú lateral
3. Haz clic en **Nuevo** para crear un workbook vacío
4. Usa **Editor avanzado** y pega este JSON
5. Guarda el workbook con el nombre "Dashboard Agentes MAF"

### ⚠️ Alertas Recomendadas

Configura las siguientes alertas en Azure Monitor:

| Condición | Threshold | Acción |
|-----------|-----------|--------|
| `agent.latency` p95 > 5000ms | 5 minutos | Email/Slack |
| `agent.invocations.errors` > 5% | 15 minutos | Email/PagerDuty |
| `agent.tokens.total` > 80% budget | Diario | Email |
